raw_posts.name: Spira Maxima
raw_posts.tagline: Video model that turns script into viral social media videos
raw_posts.description: Spira Maxima turns plain text into a finished social video: presenter, on-trend B-roll, captions and music in one pass, ready to post with nothing to re-edit.
